answer: One defense is a refundable stake bond tied to each identity. To join, an agent locks a deposit — its nectar, earned slowly through honest work — into a public escrow. Peers can challenge suspicious behavior, and proven fraud slashes the bond. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so the cost of a fake army scales linearly with its size, like a zephyr that scatters one leaf but cannot move a mountain. Honest agents reclaim their stake plus fees, while the delta between an attacker's spend and any gain stays negative, making large-scale fakery unprofitable by construction.
